digest:
Second Amendment For Every Registrable Voter Act or the SAFER Voter Act

This bill reduces the minimum age—from 21 years to 18 years—at which an individual may obtain a handgun from a federally licensed gun dealer, manufacturer, importer, or collector.

effective.note: Not enacted as of the date of the data (stage reached: Introduced). A bill becomes law only when both chambers pass the same text and the President signs it, lets it become law without a signature, or is overridden. It has no effective date.

shortTitles: Second Amendment For Every Registrable Voter Act
subject: SAFER Voter Act
title: To reduce, from 21 years of age to 18 years of age, the minimum age at which a person may obtain a handgun from a Federal firearms licensee.
